header.userPrompt:
Make the `document` table hold an uploaded file's identity + inferred attributes ONLY, and move
PROCESSING/lifecycle state onto the per-type tables. Concretely: give `receipt` its own `status`,
repoint the receipt pipeline to write it, and DROP `document.status` and `document.parser_version`
(the latter is already duplicated on `receipt`). Server-only; keep the web working.

BACKGROUND: today `document.status` is the receipt processing ladder (Ingested→Processing→Analyzed→
Parsed/ParseFailed/Unsupported), written by ProcessDocumentAction/PollReceiptAction/ParseReceiptAction,
and `ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction` also sets it to Parsed for statements. `document.parser_version`
duplicates `receipt.parser_version`. Processing state does not belong on `document` (see the
`.orca/reviewers/data-model.md` rule) — it belongs on the specialized per-type table. The `receipt` row
already exists from upload (ReceiptRepository.createWithDocument) and already has `document_id`, so it is
the right home for receipt processing status.

SCOPE:
1. Evolution (Ups only; next number after the current highest on main — main goes up to 6.sql, so `7.sql`;
   follow repo conventions; NO CHECK constraints). It MOVES process state off `document`:
   - ADD `status TEXT` to `receipt` (nullable first).
   - BACKFILL from the linked document: `UPDATE receipt r SET status = d.status FROM document d
     WHERE r.document_id = d.id`. (receipt has rows in prod, so this backfill is required.)
   - ALTER `receipt.status` SET NOT NULL.
   - DROP COLUMN `status` and `parser_version` from `document`.
   (This evolution is exactly the "moves process state off document" case the data-model reviewer allows.)
2. Receipt model/DAO: add `status: DocumentStatus` to the Receipt model + its parser + inserts; the receipt
   stub created in `createWithDocument` starts at DocumentStatus.Ingested. Add a receipt status-update
   method on ReceiptRepository/ReceiptDAO. Use Chimney where mapping.
3. Repoint the RECEIPT pipeline to write `receipt.status` instead of `document.status`:
   - ProcessDocumentAction (Processing), PollReceiptAction (Analyzed/Unsupported), ParseReceiptAction
     (Parsed/ParseFailed/Unsupported) — every `documentsRepository.updateStatus(doc.id, X, _)` on the
     receipt path becomes a receipt status update keyed by the receipt (via document_id). The terminal-
     status guards that currently read `doc.status` must read the receipt's status instead.
4. Receipt DTO: GetReceipts/GetReceipt responses currently expose `documentStatus` sourced from the
   document. KEEP the response field name `documentStatus` (the web reads `r.documentStatus`) but source it
   from `receipt.status`. Do NOT change the web.
5. ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction: it currently sets `document.status = Parsed`. With the column gone,
   REMOVE that write — a confirmed statement's state is already tracked by the draft (ready/confirmed);
   leave the rest of confirm unchanged. (Do NOT otherwise change the statement flow.)
6. GetDocument / GetDocuments: these return `document.status`. With it dropped, stop reading it — source a
   status from the per-type row if trivial, otherwise remove the `status` field from those responses (the
   web does not call GetDocument(s)). Keep everything compiling.

EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE (do NOT do):
- The AI classifier / `ai_*` columns (separate in-flight PR).
- Creating a `document` at statement upload / draft `document_id` (that is a separate PR; this PR operates
  on main's current statement-at-confirm model and only removes the `document.status` write in confirm).
- Moving file fields; any web/frontend change beyond the DTO still exposing `documentStatus`.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Follow docs/guide and CLAUDE.md. User-scoped DB access (WHERE user_id = ?); stable ORDER BY; no CHECK
  constraints; Chimney; enums over strings; never drop a Future; multi-call writes in one transaction; log
  with the userId. No dependency changes; revert incidental yarn.lock churn. Evolution Ups-only.
- Attribution: NO Claude session links (claude.ai/ or Claude-Session) in commits or the PR description;
  `Co-Authored-By: Claude` IS allowed.

TESTS:
- Evolution: receipt.status backfills from document.status for existing receipts; document loses
  status/parser_version.
- The receipt pipeline writes receipt.status through its stages (Processing→Analyzed→Parsed/…) and the
  terminal-status guards read receipt.status; the GetReceipts DTO reports receipt.status under
  `documentStatus`.
- ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction no longer writes document.status and confirm still succeeds.
- Verify per task with targeted `sbt "testOnly *Spec"` or `CI=true sbt Test/compile`; final stage runs the
  full suite.

resultJson.description:
Make the `document` table hold only an uploaded file's identity and the attributes inferred about it. Processing and lifecycle state moves onto the per-type table, as the `.orca/reviewers/data-model.md` rule requires. Today `document.status` holds the receipt processing ladder (Ingested → Processing → Analyzed → Parsed/ParseFailed/Unsupported), and `document.parser_version` duplicates `receipt.parser_version`. After this epic, `receipt.status` (NOT NULL, backfilled from the linked document) is the source of truth for receipt processing. Both `document.status` and `document.parser_version` are dropped, in one new Ups-only evolution `server/src/main/resources/evolutions/default/7.sql`.

The receipt pipeline (ProcessDocumentAction → PollReceiptAction → ParseReceiptAction) still receives a `documentId` in each job payload. It now resolves the receipt row by `document_id`, guards on and writes `receipt.status`, and fails loudly when the receipt row is missing. GetReceipt and GetReceipts keep their `documentStatus` response field, because the web reads `r.documentStatus`, but the value now comes from `receipt.status`. ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction stops writing a document status. Readers of the dropped columns are trimmed: GetDocument, GetDocuments, UploadDocument, and the bank-statement view.

This is server-only work, plus small `lib/api/shared` response-model trims for endpoints the web does not call. There are no web changes and no dependency changes. The AI classifier / `ai_*` columns are out of scope, and so are document-at-statement-upload and draft `document_id`.

tasks.title: Add receipt.status column (evolution 7, backfilled) + receipt status DAO/repository API
tasks.description:
Create `server/src/main/resources/evolutions/default/7.sql` (header `-- !Ups` only, UPPER-case SQL, comments explaining intent, no DEFAULT, no CHECK). Its first part does three things:
1. `ALTER TABLE receipt ADD COLUMN status TEXT;` (nullable).
2. `UPDATE receipt r SET status = d.status FROM document d WHERE r.document_id = d.id;`
3. `ALTER TABLE receipt ALTER COLUMN status SET NOT NULL;`

Do NOT drop the document columns yet; a later task appends that to this same file. Data-layer changes:
- Add `status: DocumentStatus` to `Receipt.Create` (`repositories/models/Receipt.scala`). Insert it in `ReceiptDAO.create` as `${receipt.status.toString}`, the same encoding DocumentDAO uses, so new rows match the backfilled values.
- Add `status: DocumentStatus` to the `Receipt` read model, sourced from `r.status`. Do this by changing the SELECT lists in `ReceiptDAO.findByDocumentId/find/all` and `receiptParser` in `daos/package.scala`. TEMPORARILY keep the existing `documentStatus` field, still from `d.status`, so the pipeline and DTOs keep working. In the parser, alias the columns, e.g. `r.status AS receipt_status`, `d.status AS document_status`; the next task removes `documentStatus`.
- Add `ReceiptDAO.updateStatus(id: UUID, userId: UUID, status: DocumentStatus, updatedAt: Instant)`. It uses `WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?` and throws `RuntimeException("Receipt not found")` when 0 rows are updated.
- Add `ReceiptRepository.updateStatus(id: UUID, userId: UUID, status: DocumentStatus): Future[Unit]` using `withConnection` and `clock.instant()`.
- Update every `Receipt.Create(...)` construction to pass `status = DocumentStatus.Ingested`: UploadReceiptAction, TelegramPhotoAction, `RepositoryUtils.createReceipt`, and any other site the compiler flags.
- Update `Receipt(...)` stub constructions in tests: ParseReceiptActionSpec `stubReceipt`, TelegramWebAppControllerSpec ~line 80-90.

Tests:
- (a) ReceiptRepositorySpec: a receipt created via `createWithDocument` reads back with `status == Ingested`; `updateStatus` changes it; `updateStatus` for another user's receipt or an unknown id fails with "not found".
- (b) New evolution spec, e.g. `server/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/repositories/ReceiptStatusEvolutionSpec.scala`, extending PostgresSpec. It brings up a DB with evolutions 1–6 only, seeds a user + document (status e.g. 'Parsed') + receipt via raw SQL (justified here: you cannot seed through the DAOs at an older schema; say so in a comment), then applies the full set. It asserts that `receipt.status` equals the document's status and is NOT NULL. Implementation hint: `val all = ClassLoaderEvolutionsReader().evolutions("default")` (or `ThisClassLoaderEvolutionsReader`); `Evolutions.applyEvolutions(db, SimpleEvolutionsReader.forDefault(all.filter(_.revision <= 6)*))`, then `Evolutions.applyEvolutions(db, ...all)`. PostgresSpec.withDatabase auto-applies everything, so use `withContainers` + `initDatabase` + `Databases(...)` directly, mirroring PostgresSpec.

Verify with `CI=true sbt Test/compile` and `sbt "testOnly *ReceiptRepositorySpec *ReceiptStatusEvolutionSpec"`.

tasks.title: Repoint the receipt pipeline and receipt DTOs to receipt.status
tasks.description:
Switch the receipt pipeline from `documentsRepository.updateStatus(doc.id, X, _)` to `receiptRepository.updateStatus(receipt.id, receipt.userId, X)`. The terminal-status guards read `receipt.status`. Changes by file:

- **ProcessDocumentAction:** inject ReceiptRepository. In `apply`, load the doc, then check `doc.kind`; BankStatementPdf skips as today, so do the kind check BEFORE the guard because statements have no receipt row. Otherwise load `receiptRepository.findByDocumentId(doc.id)`; if None, throw `RuntimeException(s"Receipt not found for document $documentId")` (fail loudly). Terminal guard: `receipt.status` in {Parsed, ParseFailed, Unsupported}. Writes: Processing, and Analyzed on a cache hit.
- **PollReceiptAction:** inject ReceiptRepository. Load the receipt the same way (throw if missing). `isTerminal(receipt.status)`. Every Analyzed/Unsupported write goes to the receipt. Pass the receipt or its id/userId down through `poll` / `pollTextractJob` / `fetchAndHandleResult` alongside `doc`, which is still needed for sha256/storageKey.
- **ParseReceiptAction:** load the receipt up front (throw if missing). This replaces the old "No receipt stub → mark document Unsupported" branch, since there is no longer anywhere to write that. Guard: `receipt.status == Parsed` → skip. Writes: Unsupported (no cache / UnsupportedKind), ParseFailed, and Parsed at the same point in the for-comprehension as today. `parserVersion` is already written to the receipt by `updateParsed`, so the Parsed write carries no version.

Include the userId in the log lines you touch. Never drop a Future: every write stays in the for-comprehension.

DTOs and readers:
- GetReceiptsAction and GetReceiptAction set `documentStatus = ApiStatus.fromEntryName(r.status.entryName)`. Keep the field name `documentStatus`; no lib/api or web change.
- ConfirmReceiptAction checks `receipt.status != DocumentStatus.Parsed`.
- Remove the temporary `documentStatus` field from the `Receipt` read model, and `d.status` from the ReceiptDAO SELECTs and parser. `d.filename` is still joined.
- Remove now-unused DocumentStatus imports and DocumentsRepository dependencies only where your change orphaned them. ParseReceiptAction still uses `documentsRepository.findById`.

Tests:
- ReceiptsControllerSpec: `setReceiptParsed` uses `receiptRepo.updateStatus(receiptId, userId, Parsed)` instead of `docRepo.updateStatus`. The existing lifecycle assertions (Ingested → Processing → Analyzed → Parsed, Unsupported on FAILED) now exercise `receipt.status` through `documentStatus`. Add an assertion that the GetReceipts list item reports `documentStatus` from the receipt; for example, after `receiptRepo.updateStatus(..., ParseFailed)`, `getReceipts` shows ParseFailed.
- DocumentsControllerSpec idempotency test (reprocessing a Parsed receipt is a no-op) keeps passing.
- ParseReceiptActionSpec: replace the `docRepo.updateStatus` stubs with `receiptRepo.updateStatus(any(), any(), any())`. Add a case where a receipt already Parsed is skipped (no updateParsed/updateStatus calls), and one where a missing receipt fails the Future.

Verify with `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, then `sbt "testOnly *ReceiptsControllerSpec *DocumentsControllerSpec *ParseReceiptActionSpec *TelegramWebAppControllerSpec"`.

tasks.title: Drop document.status/parser_version and remove every reader/writer of them
tasks.description:
Append to `7.sql`: `ALTER TABLE document DROP COLUMN status;` and `ALTER TABLE document DROP COLUMN parser_version;`, with a short comment that processing state now lives on the per-type table. Then remove every use.

**Model / DAO / repository:**
- `Document` drops `status` and `parserVersion`; `Document.Create` drops `status`.
- `documentParser` in `daos/package.scala` drops those columns.
- DocumentDAO: drop them from INSERT and all SELECTs; delete `DocumentDAO.updateStatus` and `DocumentsRepository.updateStatus`, which should have no callers after the previous task.

**Writers of `Document.Create(status = ...)`:**
- UploadReceiptAction and TelegramPhotoAction.
- UploadDocumentAction: not wired to any controller, only DocumentsS3IntegrationSpec uses it. Its dedup branch can no longer report a status, so remove `status` from `lib/api/shared/.../documents/UploadDocument.scala` Response and stop returning it. Do not fabricate a status.
- ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction: just drop the `status = DocumentStatus.Parsed` line and the import. Leave the rest of confirm unchanged.
- Test helpers: `RepositoryUtils.createReceipt/createDocument` (remove the `status` param; fix callers), `PlayPostgresSpec.createBankStatementWithRows`, BankStatementRepositorySpec ~line 80, DocumentsS3IntegrationSpec `makeDocument` and the `resp.status` assertion.

**GetDocument / GetDocuments** (web never calls them): remove `status` AND `parserVersion` from `GetDocument.Response` and `GetDocuments.Response.Document` in lib/api/shared, and from both actions. Sourcing per-type status isn't trivial for the list endpoint, and parser_version is gone from document.

**Bank-statement read path:** this reads `d.status` and was not called out in the input, so it must change too. BankStatementDAO `find`/`all` SELECT `d.status` into `BankStatementView.documentStatus`, which GetBankStatement(s)Action expose as `documentStatus`, and the web BankStatementsPage reads that field. Recommended approach:
- Remove `d.status` from both SELECTs, the `viewParser` and `BankStatementView`.
- In GetBankStatementsAction and GetBankStatementAction, set `documentStatus = ApiStatus.Parsed`. Add a one-line comment: a `bank_statement` row only exists once a draft is confirmed (statement-at-confirm model), and confirm always wrote Parsed, so this is the invariant, not a guessed default.
- Keep the DTO field so the web keeps working.

Call this decision out in the commit/PR so reviewers see it.

**Tests:**
- DocumentsRepositorySpec: remove the `status` assertion and the `updateStatus` block.
- BugFixSpec: delete the `DocumentDAO.updateStatus` case (the method no longer exists).
- Extend ReceiptStatusEvolutionSpec: after full evolutions, `information_schema.columns` has no `status`/`parser_version` for table `document`; the backfill assertion still holds.
- BankStatementDraftControllerSpec: add or extend a confirm test asserting confirm still succeeds and `getBankStatement`/`getBankStatements` report `documentStatus == Parsed`.

After `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, grep for `d.status`, `parser_version`, `.status` on Document, and `updateStatus(` to confirm nothing stale is left. Run `sbt "testOnly *DocumentsRepositorySpec *BugFixSpec *ReceiptStatusEvolutionSpec *BankStatementDraftControllerSpec *BankStatementsControllerSpec *BankStatementRepositorySpec *DocumentsS3IntegrationSpec *DocumentsControllerSpec *ReceiptsControllerSpec"`. Also `CI=true sbt web/compile`, which should be untouched but must still compile against the trimmed shared models. Revert any incidental yarn.lock churn.

resultJson.brief:
LAYOUT
- `lib/api/shared/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/api/models/...`: Tapir/JSON request/response models shared with the web.
  - `documents/DocumentStatus.scala` is the API enum (entryNames INGESTED, PROCESSING, ANALYZED, PARSED, PARSEFAILED, UNSUPPORTED; `fromEntryName`).
  - `receipts/GetReceipt(s).scala` have `documentStatus: DocumentStatus`; the web reads it, so KEEP it.
  - `bankstatements/GetBankStatement(s).scala` have `documentStatus`; the web BankStatementsPage reads it, so KEEP it.
  - `documents/GetDocument(s).scala` / `UploadDocument.scala` carry `status`/`parserVersion`; the web does NOT call them.
- `server/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/`:
  - `models/documents/DocumentStatus.scala` is the server enum (enumeratum, `Uppercase`; Ingested, Processing, Analyzed, Parsed, ParseFailed, Unsupported). Map server→API with `ApiStatus.fromEntryName(s.entryName)`.
  - `repositories/models/{Document,Receipt,BankStatementView}.scala` are the row models.
  - `repositories/daos/{DocumentDAO,ReceiptDAO,BankStatementDAO}.scala` hold raw Anorm SQL.
  - `repositories/daos/package.scala` holds `documentParser` (Macro.parser by column name), `receiptParser` (hand-written `~` chain ending `str("filename") ~ get[DocumentStatus]("status")`) and `implicit documentStatusColumn` (case-insensitive enum column).
  - `repositories/{DocumentsRepository,ReceiptRepository,BankStatementRepository}.scala`: Future + `database.withConnection`/`withTransaction`; implicit `clock: Clock` for timestamps.
  - Actions:
    - `actions/documents/{ProcessDocumentAction,PollReceiptAction,ParseReceiptAction}.scala` is the receipt pipeline. Each is a background job with a `documentId` payload, run without a user context; use `doc.userId`/`receipt.userId`.
    - `actions/receipts/{GetReceiptAction,GetReceiptsAction,ConfirmReceiptAction,UploadReceiptAction}.scala`
    - `actions/telegram/TelegramPhotoAction.scala`
    - `actions/bankstatements/{ConfirmBankStatementDraftAction,GetBankStatementAction,GetBankStatementsAction}.scala`
    - `actions/documents/{GetDocumentAction,GetDocumentsAction,UploadDocumentAction}.scala`
- Evolutions: `server/src/main/resources/evolutions/default/1..6.sql`; the new file is `7.sql`. Conventions from `6.sql` and `.orca/reviewers/evolutions.md`: header `-- !Ups`, no Downs, UPPER-case keywords, snake_case, no DEFAULT, named constraints, explanatory comments, ONE new evolution file per PR (later tasks append to 7.sql), never edit 1–6. Do not add CHECK constraints.
- Schema facts (3.sql):
  - `document(id, user_id, sha256, storage_key, kind, filename, status TEXT NOT NULL, parser_version TEXT, created_at, updated_at)`
  - `receipt(..., document_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE FK→document ON DELETE CASCADE, parser_version TEXT, ...)`
  - `bank_statement(document_id UNIQUE FK→document)`

KEY CURRENT CODE
- `DocumentDAO.create` inserts `status` as `${request.status.toString}`, so stored values are the case-object names ('Ingested', 'Parsed', …). The column reader is case-insensitive. Write `receipt.status` with `.toString` too, so new rows match backfilled rows.
- `DocumentDAO.updateStatus(id, status, parserVersion, updatedAt)` / `DocumentsRepository.updateStatus(id, status, parserVersion): Future[Unit]` are the writes being replaced. Callers: ProcessDocumentAction (Processing, Analyzed), PollReceiptAction (Analyzed, Unsupported ×5), ParseReceiptAction (Unsupported ×3, ParseFailed, Parsed with version). Tests: ReceiptsControllerSpec.setReceiptParsed, ParseReceiptActionSpec mocks, DocumentsRepositorySpec, BugFixSpec.
- Terminal guards today: ProcessDocumentAction `doc.status in {Parsed, ParseFailed, Unsupported}` (checked BEFORE the kind match; BankStatementPdf docs are skipped by kind); PollReceiptAction `isTerminal(doc.status)`; ParseReceiptAction `doc.status == Parsed`.
- `ReceiptRepository.findByDocumentId(documentId): Future[Option[Receipt]]` is NOT user-scoped; it is used by the jobs. `ReceiptRepository.createWithDocument(document, receipt, job)` writes document + receipt + job in one transaction. `ReceiptRepository.updateParsed(id, amount, date, time, merchantName, taxId, parserVersion)` already writes `receipt.parser_version`.
- ReceiptDAO SELECTs join document for `d.filename` (keep it) and `d.status` (to be replaced by `r.status`). The `Receipt` read model ends with `documentFilename: String, documentStatus: DocumentStatus`.
- ConfirmReceiptAction rejects unless `receipt.documentStatus == Parsed`, with the message "Receipt is not in Parsed status", which a test asserts.
- BankStatementDAO.find/all select `d.filename, d.status` into `BankStatementView.documentStatus`. Bank statements are only created at draft confirm (`BankStatementRepository.createConfirmedStatement`, which also inserts the document), and confirm always wrote Parsed. Tests create statements via `PlayPostgresSpec.createBankStatementWithRows` and `RepositoryUtils.createBankStatement/createStatement`.
- UploadDocumentAction is not wired to any controller; only DocumentsS3IntegrationSpec uses it. Its dedup path returns `existing.status`.

CONVENTIONS (docs/guide/*.md, CLAUDE.md, .orca/reviewers/*.md)
- Every per-user SELECT/UPDATE includes `AND user_id = ...`. DAO updates throw `RuntimeException("<X> not found")` when 0 rows change. Reusable SQL lives in DAOs; repositories compose them; multi-statement writes go in `withTransaction`.
- Stable ORDER BY (e.g. `created_at DESC, id`). Enums, not strings, in Scala models. Chimney (`io.scalaland.chimney.dsl.*`, `.into[T].withField...transform`) for new model mappings; existing hand-written DTO constructors may stay (surgical changes).
- Never drop a Future: keep writes inside for-comprehensions. Log with userId. Fail loudly instead of fabricating data: a missing receipt row in the pipeline throws `RuntimeException`; don't invent statuses.
- No dependency changes; revert incidental yarn.lock churn. No web changes.
- Tests: ScalaTest AnyWordSpec; `should` subjects name the method/behaviour, never the class. DB tests extend `net.wiringbits.core.PostgresSpec` (testcontainers Postgres 13, `withRepositories()`, `RepositoryUtils` factories; no raw-SQL seeding except where unavoidable, such as the evolution test). Controller tests extend `controllers.common.PlayPostgresSpec` with `withApiClient`, `createVerifyLoginUser(tokenGenerator)`, `.futureValue`, `.expectError`; actions are injected via `app.injector.instanceOf[...]`. Raw SQL inspection in controller tests is acceptable for state with no API (see BankStatementDraftControllerSpec, which uses `SQL"""...""".as(SqlParser.scalar[Long].single)`).
- `CI=true` turns warnings into errors (unused imports fail the build). Remove imports your change orphans.
- Verify with `CI=true sbt Test/compile` and targeted `sbt "testOnly *XSpec"` only; the full suite runs at the end.
- Attribution: no claude.ai links or Claude-Session trailers; `Co-Authored-By: Claude` is fine.

GOTCHAS
- Evolution test: `PostgresSpec.withDatabase` applies ALL evolutions. For a backfill test, open the DB yourself (copy PostgresSpec: `withContainers`, `initDatabase` (CITEXT), `Databases(...)`). Apply only revisions ≤6 via `SimpleEvolutionsReader.forDefault(ClassLoaderEvolutionsReader().evolutions("default").filter(_.revision <= 6)*)`, seed with raw SQL, then apply the full set.
- PollReceiptAction's private helpers take `doc: repositories.models.Document`; you need both the doc (sha256/storageKey) and the receipt (id/userId/status) in scope.
- ProcessDocumentAction must check `DocumentKind.BankStatementPdf` before looking up a receipt; statements have none.
- `documentParser` is a Macro.parser keyed by column names. Keep its column list in sync with the `Document` case class field order.
- ParseReceiptActionSpec constructs `Document(...)` and `Receipt(...)` positionally, so update the stubs whenever those case classes change.
- The ReceiptsControllerSpec/DocumentsControllerSpec lifecycle tests are the end-to-end proof that the pipeline writes `receipt.status` (they assert `getReceipt(...).documentStatus` at each stage).
